text:
Sofia Martinez: Heads up 3 candidate is international (Ireland) and needs visa sponsorship. Hiring manager is asking for a comp-band uplift + a split sign-on (relocation + retention) and earlier start if we can fast-track visa paperwork.
Ethan Blake: What's the uplift amount and rationale? manager justification?
Sofia Martinez: Manager requests M4 -> M5 provisional, relocation sign-on €6k, retention bonus €6k paid over 12 months. Candidate has an in-hand offer slightly higher and a relocation window.
Priya Kapoor: Routing checklist: band-exception, sign-on approval (split components), retention payout schedule, visa/immigration kickstart, payroll tax implications.
hr-ops-bot: Request 3532109876 logged. Approvals required: Comp Committee, Legal Team, Finance Review, Global Mobility. Deadline: 72h.
Global Mobility: Visa expedited service available but needs offer accepted and employer letter. If start moves earlier we may need to cover premium processing fees.
Legal Team: Retention split triggers clawback framing. Also need to confirm employment contract language across jurisdictions.
Finance Review: Split sign-on possible; tax withholding differs for EU hires. Need gross-up decision for relocation and retention. Also cost center required.
Sofia Martinez: Manager provided justification doc and cost center ENG-ML-IRELAND. Can comp committee review provisional uplift?
Priya Kapoor: Ping comp-committee for decision. Also confirm whether gross-up approved.
Comp Committee: Provisional uplift to M5 approved for 90-day review period based on market data. Sign-on split requires Legal + Finance sign-off.
hr-ops-bot: Update: Comp Committee=approved; Legal Team=pending; Finance Review=pending; Global Mobility=pending.
Global Mobility: Premium visa fee estimate €1,200. Can be covered by relocation budget if approved.
Legal Team: Drafted retention/clawback clause: 50% repay if employee leaves within 6 months, full repay within 3 months. Need approval from EVP People for cross-border clause.
Sofia Martinez: Noted. I'll escalate to EVP People for the cross-border clause approval.
Finance Review: If employer covers premium processing and we gross-up relocation, estimated first-year payroll impact ~€14k. Need EVP People or finance lead to sign off.
Priya Kapoor: Looping in @Evelyn Park (EVP People) and @Finance Director. Also tagging Global Mobility to prepare letter template.
hr-ops-bot: Approval update: Legal Team=drafted (pending EVP), Finance Review=pending, Global Mobility=ready.
Ethan Blake: Candidate said they can start as early as 2026-05-10 if visa paperwork is prioritized. Otherwise standard start 2026-06-01.
Sofia Martinez: Candidate prefers Redwood but will accept only if relocation covered and retention in place. Time-sensitive (offers expires in 72h).
Priya Kapoor: Action items: Sofia to confirm EVP approval; Finance to confirm gross-up and cost code; Global Mobility to prepare premium letter; Legal to finalize clause after EVP note.
Sofia Martinez: Escalated to EVP People via DM. Manager confirmed cost center ENG-ML-IRELAND and invoice code IRE-2244.
Evelyn Park (EVP People): Approved gross-up for relocation portion only. Retention clawback terms accepted. Cover premium visa fee from relocation budget.
hr-ops-bot: Final approvals: Comp Committee=approved, Legal Team=approved (post-EVP), Finance Review=approved (gross-up relocation only), Global Mobility=approved.
Priya Kapoor: Great. Sofia, send updated offer: provisional band M5, relocation €6k (grossed-up), retention €6k over 12 months with clawback clause, employer covers €1,200 premium visa fee, start date target 2026-05-10 pending visa processing. 48h acceptance window.
Sofia Martinez: Sending offer now. Candidate notified. Onboarding and payroll ops CC'd for Workday entries.
Finance Review: Provide payroll codes and gross-up calc to payroll ops. We'll need vendor forms for immigration payment.
Sofia Martinez: Thanks everyone. Will update thread when signed and when immigration confirms premium filing.
Ethan Blake: Also ping Eng-ops to reserve temporary remote onboarding kit in case candidate arrives later than expected.
Sofia Martinez: Thread closed for now; reopening on acceptance or immigration update.
